name: Key Ingredients
summary: Alphonse Dumas needs materials to fashion a key from a crude moulding. You are asked to bring him Thick Leather and Iron Bars.

sections.title: Materials for the Key
sections.body: Alphonse Dumas keeps the embers hot while you gather what he needs. The moulding is crude, but the right materials may let him fashion a key.

faq.answer: Alphonse Dumas asks you to bring four Thick Leather and twelve Iron Bars.
Alphonse hopes to fashion a key from a crude moulding using the right materials.

faq.q: Where do I take the materials?
faq.answer: Bring the Thick Leather and Iron Bars to Alphonse Dumas.
